name: Is BTC a Risk Asset or Digital Gold?
description: Analyzes BTC's rolling 60-day correlation with SPY (equities/risk proxy) and GLD (gold/safe haven) to assess whether BTC is trading as a high-beta risk asset or decoupling toward gold-like behavior. Area charts highlight positive vs negative correlation regimes, a combined overlay enables direct comparison, and a summary table provides current and historical correlation statistics.
source:
# =============================================================================
# IS BTC A RISK ASSET OR DIGITAL GOLD?
# =============================================================================
# Rolling 60-day Pearson correlation of IBIT (BTC proxy) vs SPY and GLD
# Positive SPY correlation = risk-on (BTC moves with stocks)
# Positive GLD correlation = safe-haven behavior (BTC moves with gold)
# Low/negative both = BTC decoupling as independent asset
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
ibit_src = market_data_source()()
close_ibit = ibit_src.c

spy_src = reference_stocks(ticker='SPY')()
close_spy = spy_src.c

gld_src = reference_stocks(ticker='GLD')()
close_gld = gld_src.c

# --- Daily Returns ---
ret_ibit = returns(period=1)(close_ibit)
ret_spy = returns(period=1)(close_spy)
ret_gld = returns(period=1)(close_gld)

# --- Rolling 60-Day Correlations ---
corr_spy = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_ibit, y=ret_spy)
corr_gld = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_ibit, y=ret_gld)

# --- Split positive/negative for area fill charts ---
corr_spy_pos = where(corr_spy >= 0, corr_spy)
corr_spy_neg = where(corr_spy < 0, corr_spy)

corr_gld_pos = where(corr_gld >= 0, corr_gld)
corr_gld_neg = where(corr_gld < 0, corr_gld)

idx = index()()

# --- Summary Statistics ---
# 1-year (252 trading days) and 3-year (756 trading days) rolling averages
avg_spy_1y = ma(period=252)(corr_spy)
avg_spy_3y = ma(period=756)(corr_spy)
max_spy = max(period=10000)(corr_spy)
min_spy = min(period=10000)(corr_spy)

avg_gld_1y = ma(period=252)(corr_gld)
avg_gld_3y = ma(period=756)(corr_gld)
max_gld = max(period=10000)(corr_gld)
min_gld = min(period=10000)(corr_gld)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: BTC vs SPY Correlation — Area Chart
# Blue fill = risk-on (positive), Gray fill = decoupling (negative)
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='BTC vs SPY: Risk-On or Decoupling?',
    category='BTC Correlation Regimes',
    y_axis_label='Rolling 60D Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Risk-On (Positive)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Decoupling (Negative)', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    order=1
)(idx, corr_spy_pos, corr_spy_neg)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: BTC vs GLD Correlation — Area Chart
# Blue fill = safe-haven co-movement (positive), Gray fill = diverging (negative)
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='BTC vs Gold: Safe Haven or Diverging?',
    category='BTC Correlation Regimes',
    y_axis_label='Rolling 60D Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Co-Moving with Gold', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Diverging from Gold', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ]),
    order=2
)(idx, corr_gld_pos, corr_gld_neg)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 3: Combined Overlay — Both Correlations as Lines
# Direct comparison of BTC/SPY vs BTC/GLD correlation paths
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='BTC Correlation: Equities vs Gold',
    category='BTC Correlation Regimes',
    y_axis_label='Rolling 60D Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC / SPY', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC / GLD', color=Color.Amber)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=3
)(idx, corr_spy, corr_gld)

# =============================================================================
# TABLE: Correlation Summary Statistics
# Current, 1Y avg, 3Y avg, period max, period min
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='BTC Correlation Summary',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['BTC / SPY', 'BTC / GLD'],
        col_headers=['Current', '1Y Avg', '3Y Avg', 'Period Max', 'Period Min'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Current', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY 1Y Avg', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY 3Y Avg', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Max', grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Min', grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='GLD Current', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='GLD 1Y Avg', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='GLD 3Y Avg', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='GLD Max', grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='GLD Min', grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='BTC Correlation Regimes',
    order=0
)(corr_spy, avg_spy_1y, avg_spy_3y, max_spy, min_spy, corr_gld, avg_gld_1y, avg_gld_3y, max_gld, min_gld)
